children.name: 1 By 2025, people benefit from resilient, inclusive and sustainable growth ensured by the convergence of economic development, and management of environment and cultural resources
Authorities and communities have capacities and instruments to implement climate change adaptation and mitigation measures for resilient and sustainable development
Authorities have the knowledge and tools to make their economic measures and policies more competitive, sustainable, inclusive and resilient
The private sector has the capacities to apply sustainable growth principles for inclusive economic development and decent jobs
Authorities and communities are capacitated and equipped to manage and protect natural and cultural resources in a more sustainable and inclusive manner
2023-2025 1.1 Authorities and communities have capacities and instruments to effectively address risks posed by climate change, especially policies and measures to promote green and just transition

2023-2025 1.2 Authorities and private sector have knowledge, tools and incentives to develop and implement policies and measures promoting an inclusive and competitive economy, including decent jobs for all
children.description: Develop adequate tools for job creation and implementation of labour market measures for labour market stakeholders (including enterprises) at the local level.

children.name: 2023-2025 1.3 Authorities and communities have the capacities and tools to protect and manage natural and cultural resources in a sustainable and inclusive manner

framework.name: Quality, accessible and inclusive education, health and social protection

children.name: 2 By 2025, people  benefit from more inclusive  and higher quality educational  programmes focused on 21st  century skills for enhanced  employability, well-being and  active participation in society
Education institutions have enhanced capacities to provide quality inclusive education at all levels
Adolescents, youth, and vulnerable groups, have improved their 21st century skills for active and productive participation in society
More young people and employers are aware of information and tools dedicated to increasing their occupational choices and skills diversification
2023-2025 2.1 Education systems at all levels have capacities, data and  instruments to provide quality inclusive education, including for digital transformation
2023-2025 2.2 Adolescents, youth and vulnerable groups have skills to increase their employability and active and productive participation in society and the economy
3 By 2025, people have access to better quality and inclusive health and social protection systems.
2023-2025 3.1 Authorities have knowledge, tools and data to provide more inclusive, efficient, sustainable and shock-responsive health and social protection policies and services

2023-2025 3.2 People, in particular vulnerable groups, have the information necessary to more effectively practice healthy lifestyles and access social protection, health services and related entitlements
2023-2025 3.3 Authorities and CSOs have the knowledge and assets to deliver multi-sectoral response and prevention programmes against all forms of violence
Relevant authorities and institutions have the relevant statistical data, knowledge, and tools to deliver more inclusive, efficient and shock-responsive social protection
Health systems have knowledge and means to provide more inclusive, resilient and preventive health services, including in response to the COVID-19 pandemic
People, in particular the most vulnerable groups, have information and instruments to access social protection, health services and related entitlements
Relevant authorities and CSOs have enhanced knowledge and assets to deliver a multi-sectoral response and prevention programmes to all forms of violence in line with international standards

framework.name: People centered governance and rule of law

children.name: 4 By 2025, people contribute to and benefit from more accountable and transparent governance systems that deliver quality public services and ensure the rule of law.
2023-2025 4.1 Authorities have capacities, tools, quality data and dialogue mechanisms to enable sustainable, evidence-based, inclusive, and gender-sensitive policies and financing
2023-2025 4.2 Authorities and public enterprises have capabilities to effectively use data, technology, innovation and standards for quality, accessible and people-centered public services

2023-2025 4.3 Authorities, including judiciary and law enforcement agencies, have capacities and instruments to increase safety, security, access to justice, and rule of law for all in line with relevant international normative standards

Authorities, including the judicial systems, have improved knowledge and access to relevant statistical data to develop and deliver more inclusive, evidence-based and gender-sensitive policy and regulatory frameworks
People and authorities in BiH make effective use of inclusive dialogue mechanisms for policy design and delivery
Authorities use more efficiently and effectively the financial, data and digital management tools to make the public services more people-centred and accessible
Authorities in BiH have enhanced capacities to ensure rule of law, access to justice, safety and security

framework.name: Citizen and community engagement for social cohesion

children.name: 5 By 2025, there is stronger mutual understanding, respect and trust among individuals and communities.

2023-2025 5.1 Individuals, community stakeholders and authorities have the knowledge and skills to effectively counter divisive narratives and enable inclusive dialogues and frameworks that promote trust-building and social cohesion
Communities and local authorities have skills and tools to enhance social cohesion and peacebuilding in BiH
Authorities and communities have the means to advance inclusive peacebuilding and reconciliation processes across the region in line with the Western Balkans Action Plan
